note: Small (20-acre) NGPC recreation area on the north bank of the North Loup River off US 281, ~4 mi north of St. Paul. Primitive camping only, no pads, at the gravel turnaround in the trees; backwater ponds and the river lie south behind the trees. Pit toilet, picnic tables, grills, playground; no water. --Claude
summary: Still NGPC (2025 grid row, Parks_Locations 'Active'/'Open', Park_Areas 2026), primitive only, first-come. Fees 10/10 confirmed; the fee note's online reservation fee was wrong (no reservations) and is removed. Facilities (vault toilets yes; water, showers, dump no) now sourced to NGPC. PIN MOVE ~6 km: stored point is in downtown St. Paul, not the SRA. Not waterfront kept. Phone conflict flagged. Note corrected (it said 'just south of St. Paul').
flags: PIN MOVE 41.20900,-98.45300 -> 41.26400,-98.45570 (elevation 547 -> 544 m, Open-Meteo DEM). The stored point is on the rail line in downtown St. Paul (~6.1 km south). NGPC's Park_Areas polygon (41.26294-41.2652, -98.45897..-98.45045), Parks_Locations (41.26383,-98.45435), Google (41.26347,-98.45441) and RV Life (41.26391,-98.45458) all put the SRA on the north bank of the North Loup River ~4 mi north of town. On imagery the only drivable open area is the gravel turnaround loop at ~41.2640,-98.4557, off the park road that enters from US 281 to the east; no pads are visible (primitive, non-pad camping), so the turnaround is the best camp point.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: south of the turnaround is ~40-60 m of trees, then a backwater oxbow pond (~100 x 40 m, about 1 acre, a pond) and another tree belt before the main North Loup channel (~150-200 m wide braided river) ~110-130 m from the turnaround. Trees screen both; no site on the water.

PHONE: stored 308-385-6211 is the Mormon Island/Cheyenne district office number (grid rows 'Mormon Island SRA' and 'Cheyenne SRA'; also NGPC's old Parks_Locations row for North Loup). The 2025 grid lists North Loup at 308-346-4715. Suggest 308-346-4715. Google shows no phone. apply.py does not write phones.
WEBSITE https://outdoornebraska.gov/location/north-loup/ not checked (outdoornebraska.gov blocked); Google shows none.

SITES count 10 and hookups electric 0 left as stored (derived from note prose): primitive-only is confirmed by the grid and Parks_Locations, so electric 0 holds; the 10 is RV Life's figure and no NGPC source gives a count.

FIT: no length limit published; a gravel turnaround in the trees, tight-looking for a 23-ft rig turning but no source says so. SAND: not applicable. Google 3.5 from 2 reviews, a thin web presence; it rests on NGPC's grid.
